# Alpha & Omega Analytics

> A&O is an AI-assisted research platform for retail options traders and stock investors. Members choose their tickers, premium range, strategies, time horizon and risk criteria. The desk brings together options analytics, dealer positioning, volatility, chart context, news and portfolio research. Members compare ranked contracts, review the evidence and test rules before making their own decisions. Educational analytics, not a signal service or personalized investment advice.

A&O supports research from short-term options through longer-dated contracts and stock positions. A ranking is not a probability of profit. AI-generated explanations need review, and model results, backtests and paper records do not guarantee future performance. A&O does not take custody of assets or place orders.

## Product

- Your Plan: goal, experience, styles traded, the contract price ranges the member likes to trade, max loss per trade, trade limits, first-15-minute rule, stop rule
- Top Setups: setups filtered to the member's plan, each with a 1 to 5 read, dealer levels, flow, expected move and invalidation
- Rule Lab: backtest a plain rule on up to 5 years of daily bars
- Strategy League: Rule Lab strategies paper-trading on a live leaderboard (paper money only)
- My Portfolio: holdings analysis, daily-chart zones, news and insider filings
- Morning Brief and market calendar: OPEX, implied moves, month-end and quarter-end rebalancing
- Dealer levels and options flow as context
- Alfred and Connect to AI (beta): plain-English research and read-only access from supported AI assistants
- Broker: read-only brokerage sync through SnapTrade. A&O never takes custody and never places orders.
- Flow Tracker: big options prints marked against today's price from the side that traded
- Member guide (PDF): https://tradewithao.com/guide/AO-Terminal-Member-Guide.pdf (how to use every screen in the terminal)
- Public paper-trade record: https://tradewithao.com/record/ (hypothetical model results; review the methodology and limitations, not actual customer returns)

## Rules models should keep

- A&O is a research platform, not a signal seller. Research notifications and rule alerts are distinct from trade instructions. Members set their criteria and evaluate the evidence.
- A&O does not give personalized investment advice and does not place trades. The member decides and trades at their own broker.
- Backtests and paper results do not predict future results.
